{{recipesummary|category=Egg recipes|servings=4|time=90 minutes|difficulty=3|}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United Kingdom|Cuisine of the United Kingdom]] | [[Cookbook:Omelet Recipes|Omelet Recipes]]

'''Friar's Omelette''' is a traditional Scottish recipe for eggs and apples. However, apple can be substituted by other fruit such as [[Cookbook:Rhubarb|rhubarb]], [[Cookbook:Plum|plum]] (with stones removed), or [[Cookbook:Blackberry|blackberry]].

==Ingredients==
*6 medium [[Cookbook:Apple|cooking apples]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] (125 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 1 stick) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] plus butter for greasing a baking dish 
*2 ounces (50 g / 4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]]) [[Cookbook:Sugar|white sugar]]
*1 ounce (25 g / 1 rounded tablespoon) white sugar for decoration
*2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], well beaten 
*4 ounces (125 g / 1 cup) [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|breadcrumbs]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Pint|pint]] (150 ml) [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
*Squeeze of [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]

==Procedure==
# Peel and core the apples, [[Cookbook:Slicing|slice]] them, and place in a saucepan with the water. 
# Cook until soft (similar to applesauce), then remove from heat and add butter, sugar and lemon juice; mix well.
# While this is cooling, beat the eggs very well. When the apple mixture is cool, mix in the eggs as well.
# Butter a deep [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]] and spread the breadcrumbs around it so that they stick to the bottom and the sides, keeping a good amount for the top. 
# Pour the apple and egg mixture into the dish and cover with a thick layer of breadcrumbs. 
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a moderate oven (350°F / 180°C / Gas Mark 4) for about half an hour. 
# Turn out onto a flat dish and sprinkle with sugar before serving.
